_: Model name -> price source, the override layer: it wins over every catalogue. Keys are a model name as ModelNames folds it (lowercase, provider path gone; '.' and '_' read as '-'). or = OpenRouter slug; near = OpenRouter slug of the closest paid model, with a note saying why; other = published price elsewhere (url + quote + optional note). Nothing is free: a model offered only for free takes its nearest paid model, and update-prices.py refuses a zero price. A slug OpenRouter has delisted keeps the last price in prices.json. A user's own model name (private route, local server, quantised copy) belongs in ~/.config/tokenbar/model-aliases.json, not here.
